fullContent:
Chintamani Ras 
 Reference: Bhaishajya Ratnavali, Hridroga Chikitsa 
 Introduction 
 Chintamani Ras is a classical preparation that maintains the balances of Vata, Pitta and Kapha Doshas. This Ayurvedic medicine is formed with herbal and mineral ingredients and is available in tablet form. It is efficient in treating heart diseases, respiratory disease, diabetes etc. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Parada (Purified and processed Mercury) – 10 grams 
 Gandhaka (Purified and processed Sulphur) –  10 grams 
 Abhraka Bhasma (Purified and processed Silica) – 10 grams 
 Loha Bhasma (Iron Bhasma) – 10 grams 
 Vanga Bhasma (Tin Bhasma) – 10 grams 
 Shilajatu (Purified Asphaltum) – 10 grams 
 Swarna Bhasma (Gold Bhasma) – 20 grams 
 Rajata Bhasma (Silver Bhasma) – 40 grams 
 Chitraka (Leadwort) ( Plumbago zeylancia ) Decoction 
 Bhringaraja ( Eclipta alba ) Decoction 
 Arjuna ( Terminalia arjuna ) Decoction 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Use decoction of Chitraka, Bhringaraja and Arjuna to triturate the powder mix of Abhraka, Loha, Vanga, Swarna and Rajata Bhasma. Then convert this to tablet form. 
 Dosage 
 Consume 125 mg-250 mg (1-2) tablets 1-2 times a day before or after having meals or as suggested by Ayurvedic doctor. It could be administered along with a water decoction of wheat. 
 Therapeutic Uses 
 
 Chintamani Ras is an effective treatment of heart diseases. 
 Beneficial in diabetes. 
 Provides good results in case of lung diseases cough, cold and other respiratory diseases. 
 Good herbal remedy to improve strength and immunity. 
 
 Contraindications/ Side Effects 
 
 This medicine must be consumed under strict medical directions only. 
 To practice Self-medication with this medicine might be unsafe. 
 Better to avoid in children and pregnant women. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
